## Case Studies

- [Pergolade Blade Pro](https://uxmillion.com/projects/pergolade-blade-pro): Redefining a premium configurator-led buying journey across desktop and mobile for luxury outdoor living products.
- [RailBuild](https://uxmillion.com/projects/railbuild): Streamlining construction procurement and product discovery for three audiences — homeowners, architects, and contractors.
- [FidemDD Website Redesign](https://uxmillion.com/projects/fidemdd-website-redesign): Redesigned financial services site to improve credibility and increase lead generation by 35%.
- [CityPups Dog Adoption](https://uxmillion.com/projects/citypups-dog-adoption): Applied Google Ventures Design Sprint to create a lifestyle-based dog matching tool prototype in 5 days.
- [Birder Mobile App](https://uxmillion.com/projects/birder-mobile-app): A mobile app to identify and explore birds worldwide using AI-powered recognition.
- [Legal & General Quote Engine](https://uxmillion.com/projects/legal-general-quote-engine): Modernizing a legacy life insurance quote engine to improve conversion through progressive disclosure.

## Services

- Starter Pack: UX audit, competitor analysis, wireframes, and actionable recommendations for early-stage products.
- MVP Package: End-to-end UX/UI design from research through high-fidelity prototypes and handoff.
- Full Overhaul: Complete product redesign including information architecture, design systems, and iterative testing.
